tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'jam dpal dbyangs sku'i khrid shes rab 'phel byed ye shes rgyan gyi 'khor lo bzhugs so//

(378)༄// bla ma dang mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi khrid kyi rim pa 'di la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes so// dang po la gsum ste/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ thum mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro bzhi dang gsum las/ dang po rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi khrid byung tshul yang*/ so sa gling gi dur khrod du/ dpal grub thob chen po mi tra dz+wa kis yi dam gyi lha lnga bsgrubs pas/ lha de dag so so'i zhal bstan nas/ rang rang gi khrid kyi rim pa bstan pa ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs sku'i khrid shes rab 'phel bar byed pa ye shes rgyan gyi 'khor lo// spyan ras gzigs gsung gi khrid byang chub lam gyi rim pa yongs su sdud pa bdud rtsi'i dga' ston dang*/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi khrid bdud dpung 'joms byed 'od zer (379)rgyas pa/ tshe dpag med yon tan gyi khrid 'chi med rdo rje'i sku sgrub pa/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi khrid 'khor ba'i 'phrang sgrol phrin las lhun grub/ dzam bha la ser po'i khrid dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba ste/ khrid drug po de dag lha so so'i zhal nas rang rang gi sgo khrid drug po 'di dag gsungs te/ khrid 'di dag nyams su long la gzhan la'ang gcig brgyud du ston cig dang*/ mi rabs bdun gyi bar du byin rlabs chen po 'byung ste/ khrid 'di dag bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa de dag /bdag cag rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gang zag sha stag yin no zhes lung bstan pa'o// grub chen gyis paṇ+ḍi ta shrī pu tra la/ des rje btsun ghirti rat+na la/ des bdag la gnang ba'o// dang po ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa/ thun mong gi khrid rnams (380)spyi dang mthun/

gnyis pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la/ ci byas byang chub kyi lam du 'gro bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid/ sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi khrid/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid ni/ bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi ngo bo bsgom la gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ bskyed rim gyi khrid/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid do// dang po la bzhi ste/ mngon rtogs bsgom pa'i khrid dang*/ snang ba sku'i khrid/ 'jam dpal dbyangs rigs lnga'i 'od zer spro bsdus sprul pa'i sku ngo sprod pa'i khrid/ grags pa gsung gi khrid/ rje btsun ngag gi dbang phyug tu bsgom zhing mtshan yig 'bru spro bsdu la brten nas longs skur ngo sprod pa'i khrid/ dran rtog thugs kyi khrid/ rang nyid 'jigs byed du bsgom zhing*/ 'jigs byed gnas lngar bkod nas dug lnga rang sar dag nas ye shes lnga rgyas byed chos skur ngo sprod pa'i khrid dang bzhi'o// dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su tshangs pa'i rgyu bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bha was stong pa nyid du bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las/ phyi snod thams cad 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi zhing gi bkod pa/ rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i sa gzhi/ mnan na nem byed pa/ bteg na 'phar bar byed pa/ rin po che du ma las grub pa'i ljon shing dril bu g.yer khas sbrel ba/ bya sna tshogs dang bcas pa/ thams cad kyang dam pa'i chos kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ bdud rtsi dang spos chu yan (381)lag brgyad ldan rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgra sgrogs pa la sogs/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i dbus su/ rin po che du ma las grub pa'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'bum ldan gyi dbus su/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥyig gser zhun ma'i mdog can/

de las 'od zer sna lnga phyogs bcur 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ tshur 'dus dhīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil krung du bzhugs pa/ dar sna lngas smad g.yogs can/ phyag g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri klad la bskor ba la shes rab kyi me 'bar zhing tsha tsha 'phro bas brgyan pa/ g.yon ut+pal snyan gyi thad kar rgyas pa'i steng du shes rab kyi po tis brgyan pa'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum pa/ smin dkyus spyan dkyus shangs dkyus ring ba/ dpral ba yangs pa mdzod spu dkar pos brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan spyi bor bcings shing*/ lhag ma'i zar bu rked sor slebs pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho dang ldan pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan cing*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus kun nas mdzes pa/ 'od zer sna lnga 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying kar ham̐'u mthing ka las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang lta bu'i ye shes pa (382)spyan drangs la dbyer med du bstim/ slar 'od zer 'phros rigs lnga yab yum 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas/ dbang bskur/ sdig sgrib dag /bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor rnam snang la sogs rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ snying gar pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i steng du/ yi ge dhīḥl/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥn maḥ ces pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyi snod la phog pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams su sbyangs/ nang bcud kyi sems can la phog /thams cad 'jam dpal dbyangs su gyur/ de dag thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags 'dren par bsgoms la bsnyen pa bskyal lo// mthar de dag thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang snying kha'i dhīḥl thim/

dhīḥnam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur par bsam la dmigs med kyi ngang la bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid mngon byang lngas gong ltar du 'jam dpal du bskyed pa'i spyi bo// mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba/ gsang gnas lngar/ pad zla'i steng du dhīḥyig dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu las byung ba'i 'jam dbyangs dkar dmar sngo ser ljang gu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung dang*/ phyag g.yas ral gri klad la bskor ba/ g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum pa/ smin dkyus dang spyan dkyus shangs dkyus ring zhing*/ dpral ba yangs pa/ mdzod spu dkar pos brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan la rin po che 'bum gyis brgyan pa/ 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin can/ gsal zhing stong la me long nang gi (383)gzugs brnyan lta bur bsgom par bya'o// de dag gi spyi mgrin snying khar yig 'bru gsum bkod la/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang lta bu'i ye shes pa gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gong ltar ro// de dag gi thugs kar yang pad zla'i steng du dhīḥyig dkar dmar sngo ser ljang khu las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras kyis sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mthu stobs rgyas par byas/ mchod pa'i sprin phung rnams kyis mchod/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang*/ ye shes dang mkhyen rab kyi nus pa thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu'i dbyibs can du spyan drangs nas/ rang gi spyi mgrin snying kha lte ba gsang gnas kyi 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga la thim pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang*/ chos dbyings ye shes/ sor rtogs/ me long*/ mnyam nyid/ bya grub ye shes rnams kyi yon tan mngon du byas par bsgom/ slar yang gnas lnga'i 'jam dbyangs lnga las/ sngar ltar 'od zer lnga 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phog pa/ gti mug /'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ nga rgyal/ phrag dog ste dug lnga sbyangs/ rnam snang*/ 'od dpag med/ mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung*/ don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sa la bkod/ chos dbyings/ sor rtogs/ me long*/ mnyam nyid/ bya grub ste ye shes lnga mngon du (384)byas nas/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi nus pa thams cad ye shes dang shes rab kyi ngo bo thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser lja khu'i dbyibs can du bsdus nas/ rang gi gnas lngar thim par bsam/ de dag gi gnas skabs su 'od zer phar gtong ba'i tshe/ rlung yang phyir gtong ngo*// yon tan tshur bsdu ba'i tshe/ rlung yang nang du bum pa can yun ring du bzung nas mnan pa ni man ngag go /gsum pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rab rgyas pad zla'i steng du/ sa las seng ge sngon po gdong thur la phyogs pa'i steng du/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dhīḥyig dmar ser las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ngag gi dbang phyug sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar sna lnga'i sham thabs can/ phyag gnyis chos ston pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis pad+ma ral gris mtshan pa'i yu ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis ut+pa la'i steng na rin po che'i glegs bam 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum pa/ spyan dkyus dang smin dkyus ring zhing*/ mdzod spu dkar pos mdzes pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog phyed bcings shing*/ phyed grol bas rked sor slebs pa'i zar bu gyen du 'dril ba/ me tog gi phreng bas skra bcings dang*/ rin po che du ma dang*/ mu tig sna lnga'i chun pos rab tu brgyan cing*/ dar gyi cod pan gyis mdzes par brgyan pa'i (385)bdag nyid can du gsal bar bsgom/

de'i spyi mgrin snying khar oṃ āḥham̐'u las 'od 'phros pas/ rang lta bu'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ slar rigs lnga spyan drangs la dbang bskur/ rnam snang gis dbur brgyan par bsam/ bcom ldan 'das de'i spyi bor/ mgrin pa/ lte ba/ gsang gnas lngar/ 'ja' tshon gyis 'od bskor ba'i dbus su/ pad zla'i gdan steng du rin po che'i po ti shes rab kyi ral gri me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ yu ba dhīḥdang bcas pa/ po ti'i steng na ral gri gyen la lang ba'o// spyi bor shes rab kyi ral gri dkar po/ de bzhin du mgrin par dmar po/ snying khar sngon po/ lte bar ser po/ gsang gnas su ljang khu lnga la yi ge dhīḥdakar dmar sngo ser ljang khus mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas par byas/ sems can thams cad la phog /mi shes pa'i mun pa mtha' dag dang dug lnga sbyangs/ 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga'i go 'phang la bkod/ ye shes lnga'i snang ba rgyas par bsam pa ni/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe dmigs pa bzung ba'o// rlung tshur rngub pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rigs lnga 'jam dbyangs su gnas pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs/ ye shes dang yon tan/ mkhyen brtse nus pa/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum mi brjed pa'i gzungs kyi sgo dang bcas pa'i shes rab dang nus pa thams cad 'od zer dkar (386)dmar mthing ser ljang khu'i dbyibs can du bsdus nas/ rang gi gnas lnga'i 'jam dbyangs gyi ngo bo phyag mtshan la thim par bsam la rlung 'dzin/ des rang bzhin ye shes lnga dang ldan cing*/ 'chad rtsod rtsom 'dzin mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang bcas pa'i shes rab kyi sgo dang nus pa rnams thim par bsgom la rlung bzung*/ des rang nyid ye shes lnga dang ldan cing*/ 'chad rtsod rtsom 'dzin mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang bcas pa'i shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas shing*/

'jam dbyangs kyi go 'phang mngon du byas par bsgom mo// mthar ni snod bcud rang la bsdu/ thig le dang phyag mtshan la yang mas rim gyis spyi bor thim/ rang lus kyang spyi bo'i phyag mtshan la thim/ de 'ja' 'od du yal nas/ nam mkha' gang bar bsam la dmigs med kyi ngang la bzhag go /de ni gsung longs skur mngon du byed pa'i khrid do// gsum pa ni/ mngon byang lngas/ rang nyid 'jam dbyangs gsal bar bsgom/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ pad nyi ro'i steng du/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ mi mgo dang rus pas brgyan pa/ ling ga gyen la 'greng ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ phyag gnyis thugs khar gri gug thod khrag bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa/ zhal ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can/ ljags 'dril zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing g.yo ba/ rwa rnon po sngo zangs zangs pa la rus pa'i rgyan drug khrol ba/ dbu skra khams ser gyen du 'khyil pa'i dbus su/ 'jam dbyangs zhal gser (387)gyi mdog can zhi ba'i tshul can/ sku stod la glang chen gyi stod g.yogs can sbrul nag rab tu 'jigs pas se ral khar brgyan cing*/ mi mgo lnga bcus do shal/ thod skam lnga dang rin po ches dbu la brgyan pa/ gzhan yang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ gi gad rgyangs 'brug ltar sgrogs shing*/ srid pa gsum po skad cig gis 'jigs par byed pa'i bdag nyid du bsgom par bya'o// de'i spyi mgrin snying kha lte ba gsang gnas lngar pad nyi'i steng du/ oṃ āḥham̐'u trāṃ hrīḥlnga zhu ba las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po spyi bor/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po mgrin par/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed nag po snying kha/ ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po lte ba/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu gsang gnas rnams su bskyed de/

de dag gtso bo'i cha lugs ji lta ba bzhin la/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ de bzhin du pad+ma/ rdo rje dang*/ nor bu/ rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin par bsgom pa'i snying khar pad nyi'i steng du/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ rdo rje/ nor bu/ ral gri lnga/ oṃ āḥham̐'u trāṃ hrīḥlngas mtshan pa las/ 'od zer dkar dmar ser ljang khu lnga 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas mchod/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mthu stobs rgyas par byas/ slar phyogs bcu'i rigs drug rnams la phog /rigs drug gi gti mug /'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ nga rgyal/ phrag dog lnga sbyangs/ gti mug (388)gshin rje gshed dang*/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dang*/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dang/ nga rgyal gshin rje gshed dang*/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ chos dbyings ye shes/ sor rtogs/ me long*/ mnyam nyid/ bya grub ye shes mngon du byas par bsgom la rlung phyir gtong*/ tshur bsdus pa'i tshe/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs thams cad sku lnga ye shes mkhyen brtse mthu stobs thams cad/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu'i dbyibs can du bsdus nas/ spyi mgrin snying kha lte ba gsang gnas lngar thim par bsam la/ rang la sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las sku lnga ye shes mkhyen brtse nus pa mthu stobs thams cad kyi byin rlabs zhugs pas/ rang nyid gshin rje gshed rigs lnga'i go 'phang mngon du gyur par bsgom la rlung bum pa can bzung skabs su mtshan sngags sam/ oṃ ya ma rā dza ham̐'u phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥwi kṛ tā nan ham̐'u phaṭa/ ces snying po'am/ sngags ring yang bgrang ngo gsungs/ mthar gsang gnas kyi las kyi gshin rje gshed lte bar thim/ de snying gar thim/ de mgrin par thim/ de spyi bor thim/ de nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar/ gsal stong mtha' dbus med pa/

skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba nyi ma phyed kyi nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa ltar// gsal stong spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la sems ma bcos par mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// de ni thugs 'jigs byed rigs lnga bsgom pa'i khrid kyi rim pa'o// gnyis pa don dam rdzogs pa'i rim (389)pa la bzhi ste/ zhi gnas/ lhag mthong*/ zung 'jug /'pho ba/ bar do'o// dang po zhi gnas la yang don gsum ste/ mtshan ma la brten pa'i zhi gnas dang*/ rtog pa la sems gtad pa'i zhi gnas dang*/ rtog med du 'jog pa'i zhi gnas dang gsum mo// dang po la gnyis te/ phyi la sems bzung ba dang*/ nang la sems bzung ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ ma dag pa dang dag pa'o// dang po ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas la/ rang gi mdun du/ ka ba/ bum pa/ mar me/ shing bu/ rde'u la sogs pa gang mthong ba'i mtshan ma zhig la/ lus gnad lta stangs dang bcas pas sems bzung*/ de la yengs su yang mi 'jug /rtog par yang mi 'gyed par/ de thog tu lhod de glod la ma bcos par rtog med du bzhag /de la byings rgod byung na steng 'og dang g.yas g.yon du sems 'dzin pa'ang shes par bya'o// gnyis pa dag pa rgyal ba'i sku la sems 'dzin pa ni/ rang gi mdun du 'jam dbyangs kyi sku gzugs bzhag pa'am/ med na bsgom la/ de la rtog pa yang mi spro/ yengs su yang mi 'jug /de thog tu ma yengs tsam du glod nas 'jog pa ni dag pa rgyal ba'i sku la sems 'dzin pa'o// gnyis pa nang na sems 'dzin pa la gnyis/ ma dag pa dang dag pa'o// dang po ma dag pa thig le la sems bzung ba ni/ rang gi snying khar thig le dud kha 'od zer 'phro ba sran 'bru tsam zhig bsgom la/ de la yengs su yang mi 'jug rtog pa yang mi 'gyed par sems bzung ngo*// gnyis pa (390)dag pa rgyal ba'i sku la sems bzung ba ni/ rang gi snying khar pad nyi'i steng du 'jam dbyangs sku tshon gang ba la sems bzung ngo*// de la yengs su yang mi 'jug rtog pa yang mi 'gyed par ma yengs tsam du sems bzung ngo*// gnyis pa rtog pa la sems 'dzin pa ni/

rnam par rtog pa thol gyis skyes pa'i dus ngos bzung nas/ rtog med kyi mig gis lhang lhang bltas las/ 'dzin med du zhig nas/ rang rig gsal stong yul med du gsal gsal 'char bar 'gyur/ rnam rtog gang skyes pa'i ngo bo la gtad nas/ rang ngo rang gis shes par byas la bskyang ngo*// de ni rtog pa la sems bzung ba'o// gsum pa/ mi rtog pa la sems bzung ba ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas la/ mig nam mkhar gtad de/ 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul thams cad rbad chod la gtong la/ yid la ci yang mi bsams par stong gsal mtha' dbus med par/ sems nyid ma bcos pa rtog med du gsal le hrig ge par mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// des bde gsal mi rtog pa'i zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa lhag mthong la don gsum ste/ dang po rgyu'i lhag mthong sems la rnam par brtag cing dpyad pa ni/ bdag gi sems 'di gang nas byung zhing gang du gnas/ gang du 'gro bar 'gyur zhes skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi ngo bo la brtag cing*/ 'byung ba lnga rang lus la skyes sam 'chi'am snyam du brtag gzhan yang sems la kha dog dkar dmar sngo ser ljang khu la sogs pa'i kha dog yod pa zhig gam/ 'on te med pa zhig snyam du brtag (391)cing dpyad/ gang du bdag gi sems ni sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dbyibs sam/ zlum po/ gru bzhi/ zla gam/ gru gsum/ nar mo/ 'jong mo la sogs pa'i dbyibs su grub pa zhig yin nam/ gcig yin nam/ du ma yin snyam du brtag /sems las rnam par rtog pa gzhan cig yin nam/ 'on te rnam par rtog pa sems yin zhes brtag /gzhan yang phyi rol gyi snang ba las sems byung ngam/ 'on te sems las phyi rol gyi snang ba byung snyom du brtag cing dpyad/ slar brtag mkhan gyi sems la yang sems kyis brtag cing dpyad/ sems de nyid yod pa zhig gam/ 'on te med pa zhig gsal ba zhig gam/

'on te mi gsal ba zhig /bde ba zhig gam 'on te sdug bsngal ba zhig /rtag pa zhig gam 'on te mi rtag pa zhig /snang ba zhig gam 'on te mi snang ba zhig /rig pa zhig gam 'on te ma rig pa zhig /bdag yod pa zhig gam bdag med pa zhig ces brtag cig dpyad du gzhug go /de'i tshe sems kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ ngo bo stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bu/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ rig pa 'gag med cir yang 'char zhing snang ba 'di thams cad skye ba med par ro mnyam/ gnas pa med pa dang 'gag pa med par ro mnyam zhing*/ brtag cing dpyad pas gsal rig snang stong gnyis dbyer med pa blo 'das nam mkha' lta bu'i don mthong nas/ de kho na nyid do zhes gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan thams cad sems nyid rtogs pa'i steng na tshang bar ngo sprad/ gnyis pa lam gyi lhag mthong tha (392)mal gyi shes pa so ma cig car du ngo sprod cing nyams su blangs par bya ba ni/ sems nyid yod med skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi 'dzin pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma'i gzung 'dzin las 'grol zhing*/ mthong bya mthong byed dang bral ba/ ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin gsal ba/ rnam pa 'gag med kyi rig pa du mar gsal cing snang ba/ bcos bslad ma byas pas ma bcos pa/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas sal le ba/ rang ngo rang gis shes pas hrig ge ba/ rnam rtog gzung 'dzin gyis ma gos pas rjen ne ba/ gang yang mi bsgom pa'i yid byed dang bral ba/ sems nyid la bzo bcos ma byas pas lhug pa/ gang shar ngos bzung dang bral bas 'dzin med/ 'dzin med rang bab tu rang lugs ma bcos par 'jog pa tha mal gyi shes pa/ rnam rtog lu gu rgyud nyid du mi 'jug pas so ma zhes bya ste/ lhag mthong gi dngos gzhir nyams su blang byar ngo sprad do// gsum pa/ mthar thug gi lhag mthong zhi lhag zung 'jug tu nyams su blangs par bya ste/ sems skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/

gsal rig stong gsum dbyer med pa ma bcos pa'i ngang la 'jog pa ni zhi gnas/ de'i rang bzhin mthong zhing shes pa ni lhag mthong yin/ de yang sems nyid mtha' gnyis dang bral ba ni/ gnas lugs kyi zhi lhag zung 'jug ste/ sems nyid skye ba med pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ 'gag pa med pas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ kha dog dang dbyibs su grub pa med pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ rtsal snang sna tshogs su shar bas chad pa'i mtha' (393)dang bral/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gnas pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ sna tshogs du mar rig cing gsal bas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ des na rtag chad mtshan 'dzin las 'das pa/ gsal rig stong gsum dbyer med pa zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ sems kyi ngo bo rang gis rang la cer gyis bltas pa'i tshe/ gzung 'dzin mtha' dag dang bral ba/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la gnas pa ni zhi gnas yin la/ ngo bo rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// bla ma'i mos gus la sems gnas pa ni zhi gnas yin la/ de'i ngo bo stong nyid blo 'das su mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// bskyed rim chu zla lta bu la sems gnas pa zhi gnas/ ngo bo stong nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// sems can thams cad la khyab pa'i byams pa dang snying rje'i dmigs pa la sems gnas pa zhi gnas/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs sgyu ma lta bu la sems gnas shing de dag rang bzhin med pa stong pa nyid du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// gzhan du bde ba chen po la sems gnas shing de nyid zhen med stong pa nyid du mthong ba lhag mthong*/ snang ba thams cad sems snang chu zla lta bu snang stong dbyer med la sems gnas shing*/ de dag rten 'brel skye med chu zla ltar mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// bcos bslad dang bral pa'i rig pa so ma la sems gnas shing*/

bdag med rig stong yul med du mthong ba ni lhag (394)mthong ngo*// mdor na chu zla dang me long gi gzugs brnyan dang brag ca ltar snang ba las gzhan pa'i stong pa med/ stong pa las gzhan pa'i snang ba med/ des na snang stong skye med nam mkha' la 'ja' shar ba ltar rtogs nas/ de'i ngang la gnas shing*/ sems nyid rang ngo mthong ba ni lhag mthong ste/ zhi lhag zung 'jug go /de ni sems nyid sku gsum dbyer med kyi ngo bor ye nas bzhugs pa'i don no// gnyis 'dzin mtha' dag sangs nas rang rig ye shes rgyas pas/ sangs rgyas zhes te de nyid 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa yang yin te/ dug lnga dag pas 'jam dpal zhes bya'o// zhi lhag zug 'jug gi tshogs gnyis kyi dpal dang ldan pas dpal zhes bya la/ gzhon nu'i gzugs sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa dang*/ chos sku la skye 'chi med pa'o// de nyid sems nyid sku gsum gyi ngo bor ye nas bzhugs pa'i don te/ de ltar sku gsum ye shes lnga la sogs pa'i lam dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i yon tan thams cad sems la rdzogs par ngo sprad par bya'o// gsum pa 'chi kha 'pho ba'i gdams ngag la gnyis te/ dang po sbyong ba/ gnyis pa las la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni rang nyid 'jam dbyangs su bskyed pa'i gnas lngar/ 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga bskyed pa'i 'od zer spro bsdu bya/ de nas gsang gnas kyi 'jam dbyangs thig le lngar khur zhu nas lte ba'i 'jam dbyangs la thim/ de thig le ser por gyur nas snying kha'i 'jam dbyangs la thim/ de sngon por gyur nas mgrin pa'i 'jam dbyangs la thim/ de dmar por gyur nas spyi (395)bo'i 'jam dbyangs la thim/ de dkar por gyur nas tshangs bug rgya mthong kha bye ba lta bu'i nang nas don nas/ steng gi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri pad zla brtsegs pa'i steng du 'jam dbyangs gnas pa'i thugs khar 'khor nas/ slar spyi bo nas mar zhugs nas rang rang gi gnas su 'jam dbyangs rigs lngar gyur par bsgom nas rlung 'dzin cing sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni 'chi rtags tshang ba'i tshe 'jig rten gyi zhen chags thams cad spang la/

'jam dbyangs rigs lnga thig le ljang ser sngon po dkar po lngar gyur pa gsang gnas nas yar rim pa ltar/ lte ba snying kha mgrin pa spyi bo'i thig le la thim/ de tshangs bug nas thon nas nam mkhar yal te/ nam mkha'i thams cad 'ja' tshon gyis khrigs kyis khengs par bsam la/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag go /de ni 'pho ba 'ja' tshon ma zhes bya'o// bzhi pa bar do'i khrid la don gsum ste/ dang po sbyang ba ni/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi sgo nas sbyang ba'o// de yang 'dun pa ni/ bdag shi ba yin/ 'di bar do yin/ bar do'i lus la bden pa med snyam du nges par byas la/ phyi snod thams cad 'jam dbyangs kyi zhing gi bkod par bsgom/ rang dang sems can thams cad 'jam dbyangs su bsgom/ gnas lngar rigs lnga bskyed la 'od zer spro bsdu'i khrid ltar bsgom/ mthar de dag sgyu ma dang rmi lam chu zla ltar gsal stong skye med blo 'das yid la mi byed pa'i ngang la mnyam par (396)bzhag pa ni rdzogs rim gyi sgo nas sbyang ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'chi ba'i tshe sa chu la thim pa'i rtags su lus lci/ chu me la thim pa'i rtags su kha sna skam/ me rlung la thim pa'i rtags su drod mtha' nas sdud/ rlung nam mkhar thim pa'i rtags su phyi dbugs chad/ nam mkhar rnam par shes pa la thim pa'i rtags su dar gcig brgyal/ de dag gi skabs su rim pa ltar nang rtags 'char ba ni/ du ba/ smig rgyu/ me khyer/ mar me/ sprin med nam mkha' la sogs 'char bar 'gyur ro// de nas pha las thob pa'i byang sems thur du lhung bas dkar lam 'byung*/ ma las thob pa'i rak+ta gyen du 'dril bas dmar lam 'byung*/ snying khar dbu ma'i nang du byang sems dkar dmar nor rgyal gyi rlung dang bcas pa dbu mar zhag gcig bar du bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang du gnas par 'gyur te/ de nyid rang ngo shes na skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro// gsum pa srid pa bar do la 'phos na/

snang ba thams cad 'jam dbyangs kyi zhing gi bkod par bsgom/ bdag dang sems thams cad 'jam dbyangs su bsgom/ bdag gi gnas lngar rigs lnga bkod la 'od zer spro bsdu bya/ sgra thams cad sngags sgrar bsgom/ dran rtog thams cad chos sku skye med du rang ngo shes par bya// 'og min nam/ bde ba can du rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i 'dun pa yang yang gtad/ der bar dor 'jam dbyangs longs rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub nas/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing khams 'dzin (397)par 'gyur ro// dge ba'i nor 'dzin rab tu rgyas pa'i mthus/ ut+pal rnam rol sa bcu rab rdzogs nas// mtshungs med bcom ldan 'jam dpal dbyangs lta bur// bdag kyang 'gro ba'i mgon du 'gyur bar shog /bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyangs sku'i khrid kyi rim pa/ shes rab 'phel bar byed pa/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ man ngag snyan brgyud du gnas pa la shin tu brjed par phongs pa'i phyir rnal 'byor pa 'od dpag rdo rje yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so/// /dge'o//
